codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: Can you still get The Hunt: Roblox 20 items?
items.answer: No — all 40 quests closed when the event ended on September 28, 2026. Items already earned stay in inventories forever; the limited-unique Shedletsekkar is the only piece that can still change hands.

items.question: Who won the Dominus Infinitum?
items.answer: Nobody yet, publicly: the official badge showed zero awards the day after the event. Roblox has not announced recipients — we track the badge counter on the winners page.

items.question: How many rewards did the event have?
items.answer: Over 90: 20 main quest prizes, 20 secret prizes, 2 grand prizes, 3 launcher items, 3 Roblox Plus perks, 21 join-year badges and 11 marketplace items.

items.question: What were the event dates?
items.answer: September 17–28, 2026 (Plus early access from September 14; final puzzle unlocked September 27).
